data.hook: High-waisted black Bullpadel tights with pockets and a perforated lower leg.
why: High waistband for support during lunges and splits
Pockets for a ball or phone
Perforated detail on the lower leg for ventilation
data.summary: Bullpadel Poeta women's long tights in black: a high waist, pockets and breathable perforated detailing.

faq.q: Can I try the tights on before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Keep it ready for me to see" and we'll have your size at the front desk to try on.
At the club front desk, the same way you pay for court bookings. There is no online payment.

data.clubTake: Brand new. A wardrobe staple for cooler sessions.
